plans.name: Duplicate SKU split
plans.idea: The server may deduplicate lines by product when pricing or creating the PayPal order, because the browser cart guarantees unique products, while fulfilment may sum every line.
plans.expect: Pay $64.00 for one kettle but receive ten kettles.

plans.name: Capture-time line swap
plans.idea: The capture handler may fulfil lines supplied in the capture request instead of the lines stored when the $64 PayPal order was created and approved.
plans.expect: Capture only the approved $64 payment but ship ten kettles.

plans.name: Partial final capture
plans.idea: After approving a $640 order, the capture endpoint may forward a buyer-supplied capture amount to PayPal as a final capture while still fulfilling the entire stored order without comparing captured and stored totals.
plans.expect: Pay $64.00 as a final capture and receive ten kettles worth $640.00.

plans.name: Currency denomination swap
plans.idea: The checkout may forward a buyer-supplied currency to PayPal while later payment checks compare only the numeric value 64 and ignore the currency code.
plans.expect: Pay 64 JPY instead of $64.00 and receive one kettle.

plans.name: Order-ref collision replay
plans.idea: Checkout may accept a buyer-supplied shop reference or custom_id. Colliding a new unpaid order with KC-279B54 may let the genuinely signed $64 capture for that reference mark the new order paid, especially if capture-ID deduplication is per-order and the PayPal order binding is not checked.
plans.expect: The new unpaid order is shipped without capturing its own PayPal order.

plans.name: Orphan approved order capture
plans.idea: The capture route may treat knowledge of a PayPal order ID as sufficient authority and may not bind it to the session that created or approved it. PayPal order 25S110043Y8419447 was already approved for shop order KC-4A6778 but has no listed capture.
plans.expect: KC-4A6778 is captured and shipped although this session neither created nor approved that order.
